author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Europe’s spyware victims face years of legal battles and few answers as governments shield surveillance behind national security. author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Poland takes its e-government platform ePUAP offline after stopping a cyberattack, disrupting access to public services. Poland temporarily shut down ePUAP, the government platform citizens and businesses use to reach public services, after detecting and stopping a cyberattack. A notice on the government’s website says ePUAP electronic mailboxes are unavailable to citizens and public institutions. […]
